Name: Expert Sitting
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is just a little bit of fun, it lets you sit on rocks and resource clumps as well as a customizable list of furniture and craftables including by default [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Ornamental_Hay_Bale]Ornamental Hay Bales[/url] and [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Log_Section]Log Sections[/url]. 

To sit, simply [b]right click[/b] on an appropriate object when standing beside it.

By holding down [b]Left Shift[/b] while pressing right click, you can also sit on building-layer stuff, but it can cause you to get stuck if you don't have something like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode [/url]or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6546]a jump mod[/url] installed. You can disable this in the config.json file.

To add items to the list of sittable furniture, just add their names to the config file's [b]SeatTypes[/b] (mind your quotes and commas!)


[size=4][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
